decisions.statement: Encoding a table and decoding the text again answers the table encoded.
The alphabet leaves out every character the game reads as markup.
A control character is never a character of the alphabet.
A value seen at least three times is put in a dictionary and referred to by index.
A caller may hand in a dictionary rather than have the encoder work one out.
An encoded line runs to no more than 998 characters.
A function met while encoding is skipped rather than encoded.
The game reaches the library through one global name.

definition: an arbitrary Lua table packed into text the game may carry and read back
